principle: Exactly one machine-readable contract per boundary. The AestheticConstraintSheet schema is owned by design-compiler; the skill produces instances that must validate against it. No copied TypeScript mirrors, no Markdown twin of a schema.

statuses.CANONICAL: The single source for this boundary. Exists on the trunk today and stays.
statuses.NEW_CANONICAL: Created by the closure; status flips to CANONICAL when the file exists and its checks run in CI.
statuses.RETIRED: Parallel or duplicate artefact. Never merged into the trunk (branch-only) or deleted from a default branch by the closure.
